title_zh: 请求检查视频导出变慢的原因

scenario.label_zh: 比较视频导出任务并请求设备性能检查
scenario.goal_zh: 说明相同视频导出耗时的变化并约定先检查而不直接更换部件

context_zh: 顾客 Finn 向电脑维修人员 Yara 描述视频制作软件的问题，不预断故障部件。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: This laptop used to render the same short video in a few minutes. Now it takes much longer.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: Did the slowdown begin after a software update or a change to the project?

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: After an update, I think. Is the processor too old?

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: Possibly, but slow processing can have several causes. I'd like to compare the same project before recommending parts.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: I can bring the original project and a note of the export settings.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: That would help. Shall we start with an inspection rather than ordering a new processor?

targets.sense_zh: 把视频素材处理生成输出画面
